newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank, Commerzbank to discuss ADIG future.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank, Commerzbank to discuss ADIG future.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank AG on Monday said it and fellow German bank Commerzbank AG would meet to discuss the future of their joint funds unit ADIG on Wednesday.
"The ADIG topic will be the subject of talks on management board level on Wednesday in Munich," a Vereinsbank spokesman said. He declined to give more details.

Platow Brief newsletter reported on Monday that ADIG's owners were unhappy with the present ownership structure and said the unit might either be split or taken over fully by either Vereinsbank or Commerzbank.
Commerzbank and Vereinsbank each own just under 43 percent of ADIG
